items.headline: Joe Burrow in it for 'long haul' with Cincinnati Bengals
items.description: As the season opener nears, Cincinnati veteran quarterback Joe Burrow, 29, affirmed his desire to remain with the Bengals, telling the team's website that he's "here for the long haul" and ready to "attack the day with a championship mindset."
